newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-FREE STATE BAT AGAINST EASTERN PROVINCE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-FREE STATE BAT AGAINST EASTERN PROVINCE.

text.p: Free State won the toss and chose to bat in their four day Supersport Series match against Eastern Province in Bloemfontein on Friday.
Free State - Gerhardus Liebenberg (captain), Deon Jordaan, Boeta Dippenaar, Hansie Cronje, Kosie Venter, Nicky Boje, Morne van Wyk, Herman Bakkes, Philip Radley, Nico Pretorius, Sarel Cilliers.

Eastern Province - Mark Rushmere, Tim Shaw, Michael Beamish, Louis Koen, Kepler Wessels (captain), Dave Callaghan, Carl Bradfield, Lulama Masikazana, Alan Badenhorst, Eldine Baptiste, Quinton Ferreira.
